Proven expertise in database optimization, query performance tuning, Docker containerization, AWS cloud services (Serverless, EC2, Lambda, RDS), and delivering clean, well-documented code in fast-paced Agile environments. Skilled at collaborating with frontend teams for seamless integrations, conducting code reviews, troubleshooting complex issues, and implementing caching and monitoring solutions that drive measurable business impact. Passionate about continuous learning, emerging technologies, and contributing to innovative, performance-driven teams that are transforming public data access through AI-forward solutions in a remote-first, high-growth setting.
